proof_summary: At \(n=236791\), a \(p\)-adic analysis of \(B_{473582}\), using Faulhaber’s identity and modular power-sum computations at the relevant primes, gives \(a(n)=14172=12\cdot1181\) with \(1181\) prime, while also showing the two required neighboring denominators are divisible by \(12\). The middle conclusion nevertheless fails because \(1181-236791=-235610\not\equiv0\pmod 6\).
